data.name: Vanquish the Horde
data.description: First the Headless Horseman had zombie allies, then we had zombies attacking the village. It's time that we deal with them once and for all by cutting it off at the source. Do you think you have what it takes?
data.successDescription: With Patient Zero finally eliminated, the last of the infected resistance falls silent. The Zombie Pyramid has been cleared, and its horrors have been brought to an end. What remains is a grim reminder of the outbreak and the shinobi who risked everything to stop it.
